title: Orbit video annotation - TEMPLATE ONLY (no real data)
description: TEMPLATE / EXAMPLE ONLY. This file is illustrative documentation of the annotation format consumed by scripts/benchmark_orbit_videos.py. It contains PLACEHOLDER values with an obviously fake product id and is NOT a measurement of any real frame: do not cite it, aggregate it, or treat it as a benchmark input. The harness ignores any *.schema.json file, but real annotations must be named <video-name>.json and sit next to their video in the dataset root (or in an annotations/ subdirectory), never here.
placeholder_notice: Every number below is a rounded placeholder chosen for readability (e.g. a 140 mm frame). It is NOT a measured product and MUST NOT be used as ground truth.

product_id.description: OPTIONAL. Stable identifier for the physical product. Used for reporting only.

frame_count.description: OPTIONAL. Total frames in the source clip, as reported by the recorder.

fps.description: OPTIONAL. Capture frame rate of the source clip.

front_frame.description: REQUIRED for a scored comparison. Zero-based index of the square-on front frame. The harness decodes this frame and feeds it to the still-image pipeline to produce the single-front-image baseline.

side_frame.description: OPTIONAL. Zero-based index of a clean profile frame. Recorded for reference; the video pipeline selects its own views.

top_frame.description: OPTIONAL. Zero-based index of a plan (top) view frame. Recorded for reference.

usable_frames.description: OPTIONAL. Zero-based indices of frames a human considers usable (eyewear fully inside the picture, no occlusion, no motion blur). Used for review, and to compare against the pipeline's own quality gate.

expected_selected_views.description: OPTIONAL. How many views a competent annotator would expect the selector to keep (normally 5-10). Advisory, not enforced.

category.description: OPTIONAL, but the ONLY field that makes template accuracy scorable: it is compared against the template the pipeline selected. Annotations without a category are excluded from template accuracy rather than counted as matches.

lighting.description: OPTIONAL free text, e.g. 'diffuse indoor', 'hard key + fill', 'mixed daylight'. Used to slice the report by capture condition.

background.description: OPTIONAL free text, e.g. 'plain white sweep', 'wooden table', 'cluttered retail shelf'. Used to slice the report by capture condition.

measurements.description: REQUIRED, and the only ground truth the harness scores. Supply ONLY dimensions you actually measured with calipers or from a spec sheet; omit (or set null) the rest. An omitted dimension is excluded from MAE/RMSE/max error - it is never scored as zero error. At least one dimension must be present.

frame_width.description: Total frame width (temple hinge to temple hinge), mm.

rim_thickness.description: Rim/groove thickness at its thinnest visible point, mm.

examples._comment: PLACEHOLDER TEMPLATE ONLY - there is no real product here. Every field is null or an angle-bracket placeholder precisely so this file cannot be mistaken for, or accidentally aggregated as, measured ground truth. Copy this structure, fill in your own measured values, and save it as <video-name>.json next to the clip.
examples.product_id: <your product id, required by the format's conventions but not by the loader>
